notes: Supplied by Shlomi on 2026-10-08 as T1500.pdf: Bituach Leumi unemployment claim form (בל/1500, 05.2026 edition), 7 pages; this is PDF page 3 (pageIndex 2), printed 'עמוד 2 מתוך 6': section 3 (unemployment period), 4 (if under 20) and 5 (if under 45, spouse income). Flat Word export with a text layer, no AcroForm. Annotated from the render and the page's own geometry (raster measurement of the 150 dpi render: underscore runs, comb ticks, Wingdings checkbox ink), never from detector output. Conventions copied from btl-bl211-2015-page2/page7: underscore blank = writing strip one text line (23 px) above the printed line, x from first to last underscore; date written on an underline = `date`, an ID or amount on an underline = `text`; a tick comb is ONE target with `cells`, bounded from the baseline up to the regular tick tops; checkbox = the printed square ink incl. its drop shadow; sub-option checkbox labelled 'own caption / parent question'. No pattern here is outside those files except the month+year comb, which follows the day/month/year `date` comb rule with 6 cells. Not annotated: the header page counter, section badges, grey bars, captions and the form footer. This page has no internal-use boxes. Checkbox bounds are the printed square without the shadow (FORM-31 convention).
